anomalies.observed: On the CAN Interface sheet the CANH/CANL pairs leave the isolated transceivers (U25, U18) and go straight to the M12-style CAN connectors J24 (CAN Interface A) and J8 (CAN Interface B) with no transient/ESD diode array on the lines. The references the spec assigns to the CAN TVS arrays are instead populated with indicator LEDs: D9 = 'LED_Dual_LKKAA' (page 9, LED Enable and E-Stop Config) and D10 = 'LED_GREEN'. No CDSOT23-SM712 (or equivalent 4-channel CAN TVS) symbol appears anywhere on the CAN buses.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table states D9 and D10 are 'CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N' providing 'CAN bus transient/ESD protection', matching the documented intended part family (SM712-TP / SM712-02HTG). The external CAN lines should carry these TVS arrays.

evidence.quote: D9, D10 — CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N | CAN bus transient/ESD protection | docs/twistedfields-notes.txt lists 'TVS Diodes: SM712-TP or SM712-02HTG' as the intended part family for this role; the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice.

LED Enable and E-Stop Config sheet: 'D9 LED_Dual_LKKAA' and 'D10 LED_GREEN' (no SM712 array); CAN Interface sheet: CANH/CANL from U25/U18 connect directly to J24/J8 pins 2-3 with no TVS diode array on the bus lines.

anomalies.impact: The two CAN buses that talk to the Odrive motor controllers over long external cabling lose their specified transient/ESD clamping. Normal communication still works, but the buses become vulnerable to ESD and motor-induced voltage spikes, which can latch-up or damage the transceivers/CM4 - a deviation from the intended protected design.

parsed.summary: The build matches the spec on the major items (16 MHz CAN crystals, LTC4412 ideal-diode path, SN74LVC1G07 e-stop/power buffers, ISL54222 USB mux, WS2812 string), but the CAN buses are missing the CDSOT23-SM712 TVS arrays the spec designates for CAN0/CAN1 transient protection - those references (D9, D10) are instead used as status LEDs - so I report the absent CAN ESD/TVS protection as the anomaly.
